Use Patch locally, with or without the browser-hosted Studio.

Download the self-contained Patch Studio Offline IDE for visual authoring and Run, or the standalone Patch compiler for source-first local build and native linking. Normal local workflows do not need a GitHub token. The Offline IDE beta embeds the same deterministic Studio site as the hosted product; host-native desktop Build inside the IDE is the next Stage 2 boundary.

PatchStudio-windows-x64.exe

# Standalone compiler
patch check app.patch
patch run app.patch
patch build app.patch --target web --out App.html
patch link app.patch --out App

Offline IDE boundary

The Offline IDE beta is a packaged local Studio, not a second implementation. It embeds the generated public Studio module closure and serves it only on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 endpoint with a random per-launch path, GET/HEAD-only routing, traversal rejection and restrictive CSP. It does not require the public Patch website to author and Run an already embedded project surface.

Stage 2 remains explicit: the downloaded Offline IDE does not yet expose the standalone native compiler/runtime through a privileged local Build bridge. Use the separate offline compiler downloads below when you need current host-native patch link output today.

Current native boundary

The current desktop line is Native GUI IR 1.7 / payload v17 / runtime v1.8. It adds bounded PNG/JPEG PaintBox draw image to the previous PaintBox Stage 1 line. Native GUI IR 1.6 / payload v16 / runtime v1.7 remains the previous PaintBox line, Native GUI IR 1.5 / payload v15 / runtime v1.6 remains the previous Shape line, Native GUI IR 1.4 / payload v14 / runtime v1.5 the previous Chrome line, and Native GUI IR 1.3 / payload v13 / runtime v1.4 the Slider-capable compatibility boundary. Versioned contracts are not silently reinterpreted.

PictureBox note: current desktop Picture decoding supports bounded project-resource and data-URI PNG/JPEG images through Win32/WIC, AppKit/NSImage and GTK/GdkPixbuf under native-picture-formats/1.0. This is not a claim of complete portable image-source rendering across every project image type or display property. Native WebP/SVG remain deferred and fail closed. Portable non-default fit/aspect/center/opacity behavior on desktop remains an explicit follow-up and fail-closes where unsupported.

Verify a download

Download the SHA256SUMS file from the same rolling channel as the selected asset and verify the exact bytes before first use or after replacing a rolling-beta download.

# Linux Offline Studio
sha256sum PatchStudio-linux-x64

# macOS Offline Studio
shasum -a 256 PatchStudio-macos-arm64

# Windows Offline Studio
Get-FileHash .\PatchStudio-windows-x64.exe -Algorithm SHA256

# Windows standalone compiler
Get-FileHash .\patch-windows-x64.exe -Algorithm SHA256

SHA-256 verifies release-byte consistency. It is not a replacement for Authenticode, Developer ID/notarization or an independent signing authority. Development artifacts remain explicitly unsigned or ad-hoc signed unless a release states otherwise.

Link locally

patch link program.patch builds a ready application for the current OS when the project fits the supported native surface. Current desktop Window output uses payload v17/runtime v1.8.

Current native Window surface

Windows, macOS and Linux offline linking uses the same current semantic GUI contract as Patch Studio's token-free Ready path. Toolkit interaction remains transient until Patch source performs an explicit change.

  • Slider: finite numeric changed value inside the declared range; native TRACKBAR/NSSlider/GtkScale.
  • Table/Grid: selected row is a transient text-list event value.
  • List-backed ListBox: selected display strings are a transient text-list event value.
  • Menu: separators, portable shortcuts and source-backed Boolean enabled/checked projections.
  • TreeView: selected root-to-node display path is a transient text-list event value.
  • Responsive layout: source-backed Anchor/Dock metadata reflows native controls without creating hidden Patch state.
  • Panel: Stage 1 native visual grouping. Full Delphi-style child-container semantics are not claimed yet.
  • Timer: native scheduling with Patch ticked events.
  • StatusBar: native/status-style text surface, with platform widget differences kept behind the semantic contract.
  • PictureBox: PNG/JPEG decoding plus the current click path under native-picture-formats/1.0; deferred WebP/SVG and richer display properties remain fail-closed.
  • Shape: rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse and line through the current native renderers.
  • PaintBox: pure paint rendering with clear, line, rectangle, ellipse, text and bounded PNG/JPEG draw image. Native WebP/SVG image drawing remains fail-closed.

The offline compiler matrix links and executes canonical responsive, Table, multi-select ListBox, Menu, TreeView, Slider, Chrome Stage 1, Shape, PaintBox Stage 1 and PaintBox image Window programs on Windows, Linux, Apple Silicon macOS and Intel macOS before the rolling downloads are published.

Slider

create number volume = 50
window "Mixer" as main size 560, 300:
  slider 0..100 as volume step 5 at 24, 80 size 300, 44
when volume changed:
  change volume:
    set = value

Moving the native control exposes a bounded numeric event-local value. Persistent state changes only because the example explicitly executes change volume.

PaintBox

window "Canvas" as main size 520, 320:
  paintbox as canvas at 24, 24 size 320, 180
when canvas paint:
  draw clear #ffffff
  draw image "data:image/png;base64,..." at 16, 16 size 64, 64
  draw rectangle 96, 16 size 120, 64 fill #dbeafe stroke #2563eb width 2
  draw text "Ready" at 24, 110 color #111827 size 16

The native PaintBox handler is rendering-only. Persistent change is rejected inside paint. Current runtime v1.8 resolves bounded PNG/JPEG data/project resources for draw image; WebP/SVG remain fail-closed on native targets.

Versioned compatibility

The current Ready/offline contract is Native GUI IR 1.7 / payload v17 / runtime v1.8. Native GUI IR 1.6 / payload v16 / runtime v1.7 remains the previous PaintBox Stage 1 line. Native GUI IR 1.5 / payload v15 / runtime v1.6 remains the previous Shape line. Native GUI IR 1.4 / payload v14 / runtime v1.5 remains the previous Chrome line. Native GUI IR 1.3 / payload v13 / runtime v1.4 remains the Slider-capable compatibility line. Native GUI IR 1.2 / payload v12 / runtime v1.3 remains the frozen TreeView line. Older contracts are not redefined: payload v11/runtime v1.2 remains the frozen Menu+list line, v10/v1.1 the persistent-list line, v9/v1.0 the Table line and v8/v0.9 the responsive compatibility line. Explicit legacy linking fails closed when a program requires a newer feature.

How Patch Studio verifies Ready runtimes

The browser path has a separate integrity gate from the self-contained offline compiler. Pages requires studio-runtime-v0.6 plus the three native runtime-v1.8 releases, reads the SHA-256 digest recorded by GitHub for every runtime template, verifies the downloaded bytes and publishes runtime-manifest.json. Patch Studio then re-hashes the selected runtime with Web Crypto before sealing a Ready app.

Studio compatibility/Console runtimesRuntime templates for no-token Console and explicit compatibility packaging. Win32 runtime v1.8Native GUI IR 1.7 / payload v17 Ready Window runtime. macOS runtime v1.8Universal AppKit payload-v17 Ready Window runtime. Linux runtime v1.8GTK3 payload-v17 Ready Window runtime.

Platform notes

Windows

The Offline Studio beta is a self-contained x64 executable. The separate x64 compiler links supported Window projects into a single native Win32 .exe using runtime v1.8.

macOS Apple Silicon

The Offline Studio beta and standalone compiler are Apple Silicon binaries. The compiler produces supported AppKit .app bundles through runtime v1.8. Development builds are ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID notarized.

macOS Intel

The compiler download is a portable tar.gz kit because the current Node SEA route is not relied upon for macOS x64. The kit includes its own Intel Node runtime and AppKit runtime v1.8. There is not yet a separate macOS Intel Offline Studio beta asset.

Linux

The Offline Studio beta is a self-contained x64 executable. The x64 compiler embeds the GTK3 runtime v1.8 linker. Resulting GUI executables still require compatible normal GTK3/system libraries on the target system.

FreeBSD

FreeBSD currently supports Console linking through the portable C99 backend. Native FreeBSD Window/GUI linking is not claimed yet, and no FreeBSD Offline Studio executable is claimed.

Use Offline Studio for local visual authoring and Run. Use the downloaded compiler for current local source checking, compilation and supported host-native application linking until Offline Studio Stage 2 connects that compiler through its narrow local build bridge.
